item.text: {"text":"The goal is to qualify controller version 2.6 at 0.80 m/s, a 2.50 ms PWM period, a maximum load of 4.00 kg, and 18.0 to 28.0 degrees C. For motor M17 only, reduce the maximum load to 2.75 kg when ambient temperature is more than 26.0 degrees C. At exactly 26.0 degrees C, the 4.00 kg limit applies. The timing limit is a 99th percentile of 3.00 ms. H2 withdraws the version 2.5 pass claim. Its corrected result is 3.20 ms, which fails the limit. Version 2.6 timing is not tested. Release is on hold until timing passes and the watchdog fault is resolved."}
